Retry policy

The client retries idempotent requests automatically when the server answers with a transient error (502, 503, 504) or the connection is reset. Requests that change state are never retried unless you mark them as idempotent.

Warning: do not retry POST /payments: it is not idempotent and a retry may charge twice.

Configuration

Set the number of attempts with max_retries on the builder. The delay between attempts grows exponentially from backoff_ms.

OptionDefaultSinceDescription
max_retries3v2.1Attempts after the first one.
backoff_ms250v2.3Initial delay, doubled at each attempt.
retry_on_timeoutfalsev2.4Also retry requests that timed out.

Example

let client = Client::builder()
    .max_retries(5)
    .backoff_ms(100)
    .build()?;

Limits

Retries are not supported before v2.0. The total time spent retrying is bounded by the request timeout (see Timeouts and transient errors).
